commentary: The Nifty 50's rebound to 25,291 is constructive on institutional buying, but a breadth score of 39 keeps the gate at WEAK. In Stan Weinstein's stage framework and William O'Neil's CANSLIM discipline, an index advance on poor overall breadth signals selective leadership rather than an all-clear market trend. Legendary tape-reading requires strict selectivity: focus exclusively on top-tier Stage 2 candidates emerging from proper bases backed by institutional volume and verified earnings acceleration. Where earnings acceleration is absent or derived from one-offs, risk must be capped at Watch, respecting the general market and cutting losses swiftly.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AARTIPHARM.technical: Consolidating cleanly above rising 50 and 200-day moving averages in a classic Stage 2 structure. Double-bottom setup cleared with 1.24x volume expansion and RSI at 68, showing constructive accumulation without extreme overextension.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Operating margins widened to 22.2% with EBITDA jumping 84% in Q2 FY27. Robust CDMO demand drove revenue up 46% YoY, while net debt-to-equity remains modest at 0.35x. CANSLIM criteria are strongly satisfied on current earnings acceleration.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Breach below 929.48 pivot breaks the double-bottom structure; exit immediately if CDMO operating leverage or working capital cycles deteriorate.

AARTISURF.technical: Textbook SEPA breakout clearing 20-session highs on an exceptional 10.24x volume surge. Price action sits firmly above upward-trending EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with bullish MACD alignment indicating strong institutional sponsorship.
AARTISURF.fundamental: Turnaround accelerated by 63% revenue growth and net profit reaching Rs 12.5 crore. Balance sheet carries low leverage with debt-to-equity at 0.42x and zero promoter pledging, though 3-year historical ROE (5.2%) requires ongoing recovery.
AARTISURF.risk: Failure below the breakout pivot at 561.76 invalidates the SEPA setup; exit immediately if volume dries up and price slips back into range.

ABDL.technical: Stage 2 advance punching to new trailing-year highs on 1.93x volume expansion. Moving averages are aligned in proper sequence (EMA21 > SMA50 > SMA200), reflecting healthy relative strength and clean Darvas box progression.
ABDL.fundamental: Revenue expanded 16% YoY to Rs 1,148 crore with ROCE at 18.4%. However, single-digit net profit growth (+11%) lags CANSLIM's 25% threshold, leaving its premium P/E multiple vulnerable to deceleration.
ABDL.risk: A close below 712.03 breaches the breakout floor; exit immediately to preserve capital given high valuation multiples and sub-25% profit growth.

AEROENTER.technical: Coiling tightly within 1.5% of its multi-year base ceiling near 160. Positioned above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI at 59, reflecting quiet supply absorption prior to an upside Stage 2 transition.
AEROENTER.fundamental: Headline net profit and sales surged following a subsidiary divestment, contributing Rs 144 crore other income. While debt is near zero, core operating ROCE remains low at 3.1%, warranting caution regarding earnings quality.
AEROENTER.risk: A break below 146.48 invalidates the pivot structure; exit quickly if divestment-fueled optimism fails to generate sustained operating follow-through.

AGARWALEYE.technical: Clean double-bottom pattern with long lower-wick session rejection validating strong demand at the base. Moving averages align positively above rising SMA50/SMA200 with MACD confirming upward thrust toward the 572 neckline.
AGARWALEYE.fundamental: Operating margins held firm at 27% with net profit growing 56% YoY on hospital network expansion and surgical volumes. Robust top-line growth (+31%) supports high market valuation (P/E ~97x) alongside strong operating cash flows.
AGARWALEYE.risk: Slipping beneath 531.32 breaks dual swing lows; cut losses per Minervini risk protocol to avoid deep Stage 3 rollbacks.

ALICON.technical: Double-bottom breakout near 52-week highs on 1.45x volume expansion. Price maintains strict adherence above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, with RSI at 68 confirming healthy institutional accumulation without exhaustion.
ALICON.fundamental: Record quarterly revenue of Rs 652 crore (+50% YoY) driven by 19% volume growth and richer machining mix (68% share). ROCE sits near 10.7%, supported by lifetime order wins exceeding Rs 1,000 crore.
ALICON.risk: A reversal below 908.77 violates base support; strictly honor the stop if auto component cycle headwinds resume.
